support.privacy.location: • PickupRadar payakavhurika, nzvimbo inoshandiswa kuratidza nzvimbo dzekutora dziri pedyo. Paunotumira mushumo wekumirira, nzvimbo yako inotumirwa kusimbisa kuti uri mukati mu {distance} kubva panzvimbo. Ma-coordinates iwayo haachengetwe, uye PickupRadar haishandise kutevera nzvimbo kumashure.
support.privacy.locationOfflineQueue: • PickupRadar payakavhurika, nzvimbo inoshandiswa kuratidza nzvimbo dzekutora dziri pedyo. Unogonawo kutarisa usingashandisi nzvimbo. Pamishumo mhenyu yekumirira neyemamiriro enzvimbo, nzvimbo yako inoshandiswa kusimbisa kuti uri mukati me {distance} kubva panzvimbo yekutora. Coordinates dzekuongorora uku hadzichengetwi pamwe nemishumo yekumirira. Kana mushumo usingakwanisi kutumirwa pakarepo, unogona kuchengetwa pafoni nemacoordinates awo kuti uedzwe zvakare. Mishumo yapfuura maminitsi 15 haitumirwi; mushumo nemacoordinates akachengetwa zvinobviswa PickupRadar painotevera kuongorora mutsetse. PickupRadar haiteveri nzvimbo yako kumashure.
